review_scope.other: CPU benchmark, pinned generators/config/CI, independent foundation experiment; generated bindings/shader artifacts reviewed at contracts and reproduction boundaries

configuration.allocator: std::alloc::System wrapped by alloc/realloc call-and-requested-byte counter; dealloc not counted

limitations: Synthetic CPU fixtures; no wall-clock, GPU, Bistro, or general performance claim.
Compile fixture has empty initial ranges and explicit dependencies; it measures borrowed names and moved order, not reductions from borrowing nonempty ranges/dependencies.
Frame fixture measures graph building after snapshot creation; finite-parameter scan removal is established by private immutable validated value, not this allocator counter.

reproduction.instructions: Use two isolated checkout paths at baseline and patched commits; create one temporary crate per checkout from the identical harness source and manifest template. Run pinned Rust 1.99.0 cargo run --release --offline --manifest-path <probe>/Cargo.toml with CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0. Source hash preserves CRLF. Counters measure allocation/reallocation calls and requested bytes, not retained or peak memory.

limits: Static review and focused tests do not prove all bugs absent.
No wall-clock/GPU/Bistro speedup or memory-budget claim.
Future general Program/subresource changes must re-establish the narrower current fixed-operation synchronization guarantees.
Pre-existing unreproduced native startup crash renderer-0pb remains open.
